"use client" import * as React from "react" import { ChevronLeftIcon, ChevronRightIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import bodyButterImg from "./images/body-butter.webp" import bodyLotionImg from "./images/body-lotion.webp" import dryShampooImg from "./images/dry-shampoo.webp" import facePrimerImg from "./images/face-primer.webp" import faceWashImg from "./images/face-wash.webp" import skinGlowImg from "./images/skin-glow.webp" import sunscreenImg from "./images/sunscreen.webp" function assetSrc(asset: string | { src: string }) { return typeof asset === "string" ? asset : asset.src } const CATEGORIES = [ { name: "Sunscreen", img: assetSrc(sunscreenImg) }, { name: "Face Wash", img: assetSrc(faceWashImg) }, { name: "Skin Glow", img: assetSrc(skinGlowImg) }, { name: "Dry Shampoo", img: assetSrc(dryShampooImg) }, { name: "Body Butter", img: assetSrc(bodyButterImg) }, { name: "Face Primer", img: assetSrc(facePrimerImg) }, { name: "Body Lotion", img: assetSrc(bodyLotionImg) }, ] as const export default function ProductCategories({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"section">) { const scrollerRef = React.useRef(null) const scrollShelf = React.useCallback((toward: "prev" | "next") => { const el = scrollerRef.current if (!el) return const delta = Math.min(280, Math.max(160, el.clientWidth * 0.7)) const rtl = getComputedStyle(el).direction === "rtl" const sign = toward === "next" ? 1 : -1 el.scrollBy({ left: sign * delta * (rtl ? -1 : 1), behavior: "smooth", }) }, []) return (
